output_dir.description: Directory where decompressed files are stored. If null or empty, files are written to current directory.

buffer_size.description: Output buffer size in bytes for low-memory mode. Can be a power of two (12-29) or explicit byte count. 15 = 32KB.

keep.description: Keep (don't delete) input files after decompression.

quiet.description: Suppress all messages. Takes precedence over verbose.

test.description: Test compressed file integrity instead of decompressing.

stdout.description: Write output to standard output instead of a file.

trailing_error.description: Exit with error status if trailing data is found after valid lzip data.

loose_trailing.description: Allow trailing data, even if it seems corrupt.

list_mode.description: Print compressed and uncompressed file sizes instead of decompressing.

files.description: List of input .lz files to process. If empty, stdin is assumed or default behavior applies.
